title: Lobed Mirror with a Tortoise Knob, Musician, and Phoenix
text_changes: None; translated fields and remarks reproduced verbatim

passages.text:
A mirror with paired phoenixes is cast from metals from the South.
The yin and yang are made to match;
The sun and moon meet with constancy.
A white jade box with peony decor
Is mated with a lustrous tassel of 
kingfisher feathers.
Those of the same heart beat are drawn close.
Whatever the mirror will reveal: be they hearts 
or gall;
It will surely protect you for a thousand springs.
passages.source_text: 鳳凰雙鏡南金裝。陰陽各為配，日月恒相會。白玉芙蓉匣，翠羽瓊瑤帶。同心人，心相親，照心照膽保千春。

note: Complete museum-published inscription rendering; AncientLens scholarly review remains unreviewed. The museum transcribes the continuous inscription from the paired-phoenix dedication through the final thousand-springs blessing, with corresponding English rendering.
